<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0011-container-with-most-water.py</code></summary>

```python
class Solution:
    def maxArea(self,height: list[int]) -> int:
        left_idx = 0
        right_idx = len(height) - 1
        currArea = abs(left_idx - right_idx) * min(height[right_idx], height[left_idx])

        while left_idx < right_idx:
            if height[left_idx] <= height[right_idx]:
                left_idx += 1

            elif height[left_idx] > height[right_idx]:
                right_idx -= 1
            
            #recalculate the area
            temp_area = abs(left_idx - right_idx) * min(height[right_idx], height[left_idx])

            if temp_area > currArea:
                currArea = temp_area
        
        return currArea
```

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>C++</b> (spoiler) · <code>0011-container-with-most-water.cpp</code></summary>

```cpp
class Solution {
public:
    int maxArea(vector<int>& height) {
        int left = 0;
        int right = height.size() - 1;
        int maxarea = -1;

        while( left < right ){
            int length = min(height[left], height[right]);
            int width = right - left;

            maxarea = max(maxarea, ( length * width ));
            
            if(height[left] >= height[right]){
                right --;
            }else{
                left ++;
            }
        }

        return maxarea;
    }
};
```

</details>
